context.measurement_method: estimate from published plasma EV abundances and a mouse-derived plasma mean residence time

records.statement: Total plasma EV secretion rate needed to maintain the steady-state plasma EV level in healthy humans.
limitations: Derived from literature values, not measured directly.
Uses a residence time inferred from mouse studies.

context.measurement_method: estimate from cell-specific plasma EV abundance

records.statement: Highest estimated cell-specific basal EV secretion rate among human blood cells (monocytes).
limitations: Model-based estimate, not an in vivo measurement.
Basal state only.

context.measurement_method: cell culture secretion measurement reported by the cited study

records.statement: Cultured HepG2 cells secrete roughly one EV per 15 minutes per cell.
limitations: Secondary citation; the primary study has not yet been reviewed here.
Culture conditions differ from tissue.

context.measurement_method: ratio of cell-specific plasma EV counts to parent cell counts

records.statement: Cell-specific plasma EV-to-parent-cell ratios span four orders of magnitude, from erythrocytes (0.13) to monocytes (about 1.9e3).
limitations: Inferred from heterogeneous literature measurements.

context.measurement_method: luciferase activity in blood after intravenous injection

records.statement: Intravenously injected B16-BL6 exosomes left the blood circulation with a half-life of about 2 minutes.
limitations: Exogenous tumour-cell EVs in mice; endogenous human EVs may differ.
Approximate value from a pharmacokinetic fit.

context.ev_preparation: mouse plasma-derived small EVs labelled with an sEV-specific luciferase tag
context.measurement_method: intravenous pharmacokinetic analysis

records.statement: Mouse plasma-derived small EVs disappeared from blood with a half-life of about 7 minutes.
limitations: Mouse; human plasma EV half-life is not directly measured here.

context.measurement_method: pharmacokinetic model of secretion/clearance balance

records.statement: Plasma small-EV secretion rate in mice estimated by pharmacokinetic analysis, expressed as protein mass.
limitations: Mass-based (protein), not particle-based.
Depends on the two-compartment model assumptions.

context.measurement_method: NanoLuc luciferase activity
context.experimental_conditions: 1 h incubation; 4 degC control gave 0.4 +/- 0.2% association

records.statement: About 1% of added EVs became cell-associated/internalized after 1 h; uptake did not saturate at doses of 100 ug/mL protein or higher.
limitations: Bulk culture fraction: depends on dose, medium volume and transport to the cell layer, so it is not a cell-intrinsic rate constant.

context.measurement_method: detergent-free fractionation and luciferase activity

records.statement: Of the internalized EV cargo, about 27% reached the cytosol; bafilomycin A1 reduced this release without changing uptake.
limitations: Single cargo reporter and cell line.

context.measurement_method: imaging flow cytometry

records.statement: HEK293T EV uptake was dose- and time-dependent with a minimum detectable dose of about 6,000 EVs per cell at 4 h.
limitations: Detection threshold of the assay, not a biological threshold.

context.measurement_method: controlled flow in a laminin-rich ECM microfluidic device

records.statement: Physiological interstitial flow range applied in the device; under these flows convection dominated EV transport and integrin-mediated ECM binding shaped concentration gradients.
limitations: Imposed experimental range, not measured in a specific tissue.

context.measurement_method: nanoparticle tracking analysis
context.experimental_conditions: 20 healthy subjects, fasting and postprandial sampling

records.statement: Estimated reference interval of submicron particle concentration in platelet-free plasma by NTA.
limitations: NTA counts all submicron particles, including lipoproteins; not EV-specific.

records.statement: Published plasma EV concentration estimates span five orders of magnitude, reflecting isolation losses, contaminating particles and detection limits.
limitations: Range of literature estimates, not a distribution.

context.measurement_method: nanoparticle tracking analysis

records.statement: Small EVs released into plasma during exercise had diameters of about 100-130 nm.
limitations: Exercise-released subpopulation.

context.measurement_method: confocal signal by distance from donor boundary

records.statement: Half of the above-background EV signal lies within 17 um of the donor boundary (80% within 40 um; <5% beyond 100 um), from an exponential fit.
limitations: Fit-derived summary; raw data on request only.

context.measurement_method: TIRF microscopy of mCh-CD63-pHluorin fusion events

records.statement: Glucocorticoids stimulated small-EV secretion in a neuronal cell line; the effect required Rab27a and nSMase2 activation downstream of mitochondrial ROS.
limitations: Preprint at time of review.
Cell-line context; no human dose-response.

context.measurement_method: EV isolation by ultracentrifugation

records.statement: Norepinephrine increased small-EV number, diameter and ACE content from adventitial fibroblasts; the release was abolished by GW4869.
mechanism: alpha-adrenergic receptor dependence shown for the downstream proliferation effect
limitations: Rat primary cells, hypertension model.

stimulus.name: acute physical stress (cortisol and catecholamines elevated)

records.time_course: rapid rise, return to baseline within 40 min

context.measurement_method: imaging flow cytometry (CD9, CD63, CD81, CD44)

records.statement: Physical stress raised circulating CD9+ and CD63+ small EVs rapidly with return to baseline within 40 min; psychosocial stress raised cortisol but gave heterogeneous, non-directional EV responses.
limitations: Association with hormone changes; no causal attribution to a single hormone.

records.time_course: declined again within 90 min at rest
records.locator: abstract; fold change from secondary review table

context.measurement_method: nanoparticle tracking analysis

records.statement: Cycling exercise raised plasma small EVs about 2.7-fold (running about 1.5-fold); levels declined within 90 min.
limitations: Fold changes taken from a secondary review table.

records.statement: Insulin infusion decreased circulating medium-sized EVs in adults with metabolic syndrome.
limitations: Circulating level reflects release and clearance; recorded as the observed concentration, not attributed to release.

context.measurement_method: small-EV miRNA profiling

records.statement: Insulin changed the sEV miRNA cargo of adipocytes (53 up, 66 down) largely independent of cellular levels, partly via hnRNPA1 phosphorylation.
limitations: Cargo effect; no transport rate change implied.

context.experimental_conditions: obese subjects; primary adipocytes stressed with palmitic acid

records.statement: Circulating EV number correlated with fasting plasma insulin and HOMA-IR; stressed primary adipocytes released more EVs.
limitations: Correlation, not a controlled hormone exposure.

context.measurement_method: EV isolation by differential centrifugation and SEC; proteomics

records.statement: EV numbers were independent of hormonal stimulation, but EV size and proteome changed with E2/P4 treatment.
limitations: Single cell line model of endometrium.

records.statement: Clearance of injected exosomes from blood was much slower in macrophage-depleted mice, identifying macrophages as main clearance route.
limitations: Exogenous EVs.

stimulus.name: matrix stress relaxation (viscoelastic vs elastic hydrogel)

records.observable: EV mobility and release from hydrogel

context.measurement_method: 3D particle tracking and release assays

records.statement: EVs became confined in elastic hydrogels but moved through stress-relaxing matrices; release of EVs, unlike dextran or synthetic nanoparticles, depended on matrix mechanics, and water permeation (aquaporin-1) was required.
limitations: Engineered hydrogels; no tissue diffusion coefficient recorded here.

context.measurement_method: imaging flow cytometry of CD63-pHluorin-rich compartments, extrapolated from 2.5 um slices

records.statement: About 70 CD63-pHluorin-rich compartments per 2.5 um optical slice, extrapolated to about 200 per cell, consistent with endogenous late-endosome numbers; most are 400-600 nm in diameter.
limitations: Extrapolated from slices; reporter-expressing cells.

context.ev_preparation: platelet microparticles in apheresis platelet concentrates
context.measurement_method: flow cytometry (annexin V)

records.statement: Transfused platelet microparticles declined in human plasma with a half-life of 5.8 h (annexin V; 95% CI 1.8-18.3 h); CD61 gave 5.3 h (95% CI 2.0-14.2 h).
limitations: Large platelet-derived microparticles in thrombocytopenic patients; not small EVs.
Low/high are the 95% CI, central is the point estimate.

context.ev_preparation: platelet microparticles in apheresis platelet concentrates
context.measurement_method: flow cytometry (CD61)

records.statement: Transfused platelet microparticles (CD61+) declined in human plasma with a half-life of 5.3 h (95% CI 2.0-14.2 h).
limitations: Large platelet-derived microparticles in thrombocytopenic patients; not small EVs.
Low/high are the 95% CI, central is the point estimate.

context.tissue: normal and neoplastic tissue in a transparent ear chamber
context.measurement_method: fluorescence recovery after photobleaching

records.statement: Average interstitial fluid velocity of about 0.6 um/s, generally directed into postcapillary venules.
limitations: Ear-chamber tissue in rabbit; tumour-specific flows may differ.

context.measurement_method: fluorescence recovery after photobleaching of bovine serum albumin

records.statement: Albumin diffused through normal interstitium with D = 5.8 +/- 1.3 x 10^-7 cm^2/s (neoplastic tissue 6.3 +/- 1.9 x 10^-7 cm^2/s).
limitations: Albumin (~7 nm) is far smaller than EVs; a hindrance reference only.

context.measurement_method: real-time iontophoresis with tetramethylammonium

records.statement: The brain extracellular space typically occupies about 20% of tissue volume, with tortuosity about 1.6 for small molecules.
limitations: Small-molecule probes; pathology changes both (e.g. severe ischaemia alpha 0.04, lambda 2.2).

context.measurement_method: inferred from diffusion analysis

records.statement: Estimated width of the brain extracellular space is 38-64 nm.
limitations: Model-based estimate of an average channel width.

context.measurement_method: TIRF imaging of CD63-pHluorin MVB-plasma membrane fusion

records.statement: Histamine H1 receptor stimulation induced MVB-plasma membrane fusion (exosome release) in single cells; depletion of SNAP23 or syntaxin-4 reduced fusion frequency.
limitations: Short-term single-cell imaging; reporter-expressing cells.

magnitude.observable: plasma exosome concentration, pregnant vs non-pregnant

context.measurement_method: CD63 and placental PLAP immunoassays on isolated exosomes
context.experimental_conditions: n = 20 per trimester group plus non-pregnant controls

records.statement: Plasma exosome concentration was more than 50-fold higher in pregnant than non-pregnant women and rose more than twofold with gestational age.
limitations: Immunoreactive exosome quantification; isolation-dependent.

context.measurement_method: NTA and exosomal PLAP immunoassay
context.experimental_conditions: 10 women sampled weekly from 6 to 12 weeks (n = 70)

records.statement: Placenta-derived (PLAP+) exosomes in maternal plasma rose progressively from 70.6 +/- 5.7 pg/mL at 6 weeks to 117.5 +/- 13.4 pg/mL at 12 weeks.
limitations: PLAP mass concentration, not particle counts.

context.measurement_method: NTA and CD63 immunoblotting

records.statement: Moderate and severe hypoxia increased exosome release in three breast cancer lines; HIF-1alpha siRNA prevented the increase and the HIF hydroxylase inhibitor DMOG mimicked it.
limitations: Cancer cell lines; fold changes not recorded here.

context.measurement_method: western blot and CD9 EV TR-FIA after sequential ultracentrifugation

records.statement: DHT specifically increased CD9-positive EV secretion from androgen-responsive prostate cancer cells.
limitations: Prostate cancer cell lines; marker-specific readout.

context.measurement_method: S-EV characterisation and small RNA sequencing

records.statement: Androgen manipulation altered the heterogeneity and size of CD9-positive small EVs and their small RNA cargo in AR-expressing cells.
limitations: Direction of the size change is not recorded here.

records.statement: Physiological doses of 17beta-estradiol increased EV production dose-dependently in ER+ breast cancer cells and enriched specific miRNAs in EV cargo.
limitations: Dose-response values are not recorded here.

context.cell_type: cultured vascular endothelial cells; ovariectomized mice

records.statement: E2 raised APE1/Ref-1 in CD63-positive exosomes; secretion depended on ER and intracellular calcium and was inhibited by GW4869.
limitations: Single cargo protein.

context.measurement_method: TEM of MVBs, NTA, acetylcholinesterase activity

records.statement: Leptin increased MVB numbers and exosome release; the leptin receptor antagonist LDFI abrogated the effect, which involved Tsg101 stabilisation via Hsp90.
limitations: Breast cancer cell lines; supraphysiological concentration.

records.statement: Melatonin reduced misfolded proteins carried by EVs from preeclamptic placentae and their ability to activate endothelial cells.
limitations: Ex vivo placental explants.

context.measurement_method: high-resolution nano flow cytometry

records.statement: Relative size and concentration of plasma EVs varied across the day in healthy adults.
limitations: Relative proportions; small cohort.

context.measurement_method: NTA and LC-MS of sEV markers
context.experimental_conditions: n = 10 healthy adults, fed and fasted days

records.statement: CD81 on serum sEVs decreased and the liver marker ASGR1 increased between morning and afternoon samples.
limitations: Two time points only.

records.statement: Large plasma EVs were bigger at 10:00 than at 22:00, and EV miRNA content showed day-night variation.
limitations: Direction recorded for the 10:00 sample relative to 22:00.

context.measurement_method: single-particle tracking and confocal reflectance microscopy

records.statement: EV membrane integrins mediated binding to collagen I; integrin inhibition increased EV mobility in the matrix.
limitations: Hydrogel model; no diffusion coefficient recorded here.
